forecaster_note: Wed: weak, peaky and wobbly waist-high from short period swell — rideable, not exciting; light N winds this morning are the cleanest window, then NE'lies. Thu: a bit more NE/ENE size, chest high with a few head-high sets, mixed up and junky; S-facing breaks / N corners. Fri: short-period ENE/NE mix continues, maybe a little longer S swell; winds better at dawn. Sat: chest to head high, N/NW dawn then NE. — Surfline forecaster (Hugh), Wed 21 Oct
